ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a food web; on the left there is “Leaves & Algae”, with arrows pointing to Mayflies, Stoneflies, Caddis Flies, etc.; the arrows related to these insects continue to point to “Trout”. On the right, an arrow from “Trout” to “Humans” is clearly visible. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows go from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it, that is, from food/prey to consumer/predator. Because the arrow goes from Trout to Humans, it shows that humans eat trout. Therefore, humans are predator with respect to trout.
